entities.summary: Emilie Cosman, known as Milein Cosman, was a German-born British artist. She was best known for her graphic work of leading cultural figures, dancers and musicians in action, such as Francis Bacon, Mikhail Baryshnikov, T. S. Eliot, and Igor Stravinsky.
